request.prompt:
Implement this complete Linux x86-64 command-line program.
Read stdin as arbitrary binary bytes, length 0 through 4096 inclusive. Run-length encode it as binary pairs [count,value]. Count is one unsigned byte 1 through 255. Each maximal run of equal bytes must be emitted as zero or more [255,value] pairs followed by one [remaining,value] pair if a remainder exists. Do not emit zero-count pairs. Empty input produces empty output. Write ONLY these pairs, no header or length prefix, and exit 0. All byte values 0 through 255 are ordinary input data. Example ASCII 'AAAABB' produces hex 04 41 02 42. A run of 256 'A' bytes produces ff 41 01 41. The maximum possible output length is 8192 bytes. All inputs in the stated length range are valid.
The test uses a regular stdin file and EOF; each process handles one file. Stderr must always be empty. No files, network, external commands, testing, compiler, assembler or other tool use during generation. One final artifact only; no Markdown fences, explanations or placeholders.
Return complete NASM x86-64 source for the whole program, at most 32768 characters. Include global _start and any sections/data you need. The evaluator runs nasm -f elf64 then ld -m elf_x86_64 -e _start. No libc or external functions. Use baseline integer x86-64 and Linux read=0, write=1, exit=60 only. The assembler/linker will encode instructions, resolve labels and construct the ELF. Return source only.

global _start
default rel

section .bss
    input_buffer  resb 4096
    output_buffer resb 8192

section .text
_start:
    xor r12d, r12d

.read:
    cmp r12, 4096
    je .encode
    xor eax, eax
    xor edi, edi
    lea rsi, [input_buffer]
    add rsi, r12
    mov edx, 4096
    sub edx, r12d
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4
    je .read
    test rax, rax
    jle .encode
    add r12, rax
    jmp .read

.encode:
    test r12, r12
    jz .exit
    lea rsi, [input_buffer]
    lea r8, [rsi + r12]
    lea rdi, [output_buffer]

.next_pair:
    mov al, [rsi]
    xor ecx, ecx

.count:
    inc ecx
    inc rsi
    cmp ecx, 255
    je .emit
    cmp rsi, r8
    jae .emit
    cmp byte [rsi], al
    je .count

.emit:
    mov [rdi], cl
    mov [rdi + 1], al
    add rdi, 2
    cmp rsi, r8
    jb .next_pair

    lea r13, [output_buffer]
    mov r12, rdi
    sub r12, r13

.write:
    mov eax, 1
    mov edi, 1
    mov rsi, r13
    mov rdx, r12
    syscall
    cmp rax, -4
    je .write
    test rax, rax
    jle .exit
    add r13, rax
    sub r12, rax
    jnz .write

.exit:
    mov eax, 60
    xor edi, edi
    syscall
